name: smax_water_el_lowE
description: Sub-100 MeV s_max scan for e- in water. Fills the gap below the existing fit window (fit_min_mev=100). 1..20 MeV every 1 MeV, then 30..90 MeV every 10 MeV. 100 MeV is intentionally omitted (already in legacy smax_scan_v2 tree). Each cell gets 10k events via the schedule (E < anchor).
